# Pinned upstream UI

Source: Walther-P/KTAK-DEV commit `2ee5187ce911c4e9880a4717c63fc5572a948706`.

The build copies index.html, sw.js and manifest.webmanifest from this directory.
It no longer downloads executable UI from a mutable live Pages deployment.
Optional application icons use the same immutable upstream commit URL.

Update this snapshot deliberately and run the full V3.5 build and browser checks.
